digest.component_or_area: rebar review command and review_ticket library/MCP surface
propositions: rebar review verb must be retired by converting it to a forwarding shim over review-plan that preserves unsigned (no attestation) semantics via --no-sign flag
The shim must reject --graph and positional reviewer_id arguments with exit code 2 and message naming review-plan, preventing silent acceptance of unsupported arguments

rebar.llm.review_ticket public library function must emit a DeprecationWarning when called, while three internal call sites (_mcp_llm, review_workflows, eval_solver) must call private _review_ticket_impl to avoid double-signalling
Three deprecation rows (cli, lib, mcp kinds) must be registered in _deprecations.py with scheduled removal in v1.0.0, routing via stderr/warning/log respectively
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["review"] must be rewired to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT and REVIEW_RESULT moved to synthetic "review_ticket" key, with no schema left orphaned
